dataset.also_known_as: RSNA 2019 Brain CT Hemorrhage Challenge dataset
dataset.publisher: Radiological Society of North America (RSNA), with ASNR and contributing research institutions
dataset.label_format: CSV; one image identifier per label row

published_scope.scope_note: Published dataset-level figures; not verified counts for a local RADAR AI copy.

sources.citation: Flanders AF, Prevedello LM, Shih G, et al. Construction of a Machine Learning Dataset through Collaboration: The RSNA 2019 Brain CT Hemorrhage Challenge. Radiology: Artificial Intelligence. 2020;2(3).

usage_assessment.assessment_note: Apply the stricter AWS registry restriction while the official RSNA redistribution language conflict remains unresolved. Seek written clarification from RSNA before any redistribution or commercial use.

local_copy.note: No source DICOMs or labels CSV were available in the workspace. Do not replace nulls with published aggregate counts; do not store patient identifiers here.

immutability.update_rule: Create a new manifest revision for newly acquired source snapshots or changed terms; preserve prior revisions in version history.
